name: Advanced Biomechanics
description: This course aims to provide an in-depth understanding of the mechanical principles governing biological systems, with a particular emphasis on the mechanics of biological cells, soft-tissues and musculoskeletal systems. It integrates theoretical knowledge with practical skills in experimental methods and computational modeling to analyze and interpret biomechanical data effectively.
